gist.en: Ship that produces and stores oil at sea
gist.no: Skip som produserer og lagrer olje til havs

description.en: A ship-shaped vessel moored over an offshore field that receives well fluids, separates oil, gas and water, stores the oil in its hull and offloads it to shuttle tankers. Used where a pipeline to shore is impractical.
description.no: Et skipsformet fartøy forankret over et havfelt som mottar brønnstrømmer, separerer olje, gass og vann, lagrer oljen i skroget og losser den over til skytteltankere. Brukes der rørledning til land ikke er praktisk.

gist.en: Valve stack that stops a well blowing out
gist.no: Ventilstabel som stopper en brønn i å blåse ut

description.en: Stack of large valves on top of a well that can seal the wellbore and shut off uncontrolled flow of oil or gas. Two main types are combined in a stack: annular preventers, which use a rubber element to close around any pipe size, and ram preventers, which drive steel rams across the bore — some able to shear the drill pipe itself.
description.no: Stabel av store ventiler på toppen av en brønn som kan tette brønnhullet og stanse ukontrollert utstrømning av olje eller gass. To hovedtyper kombineres i stabelen: annulære preventere, som bruker et gummielement til å tette rundt alle rørdimensjoner, og ram-preventere, som skyver stålrammer på tvers av brønnhullet — noen kan kutte selve borestrengen.

entries._source: Web research: Enverus glossary, Wikipedia, industry sources, Sept 2026
entries.note: Triggered by a formation kick — a sudden pressure surge from the reservoir. The BOP is the last barrier against a blowout, which is why its failure on Deepwater Horizon in 2010 became the industry's reference case for well-control equipment integrity.

gist.en: Shuts the plant down when something goes wrong
gist.no: Stenger anlegget ved feil eller fare

description.en: Safety system that automatically or manually shuts down process equipment, isolates inventories and stops flow when a dangerous condition such as fire, gas leak or overpressure is detected. Built in three layers: sensors, a logic solver running cause-and-effect logic, and final elements such as ESD valves that fail to a safe position.
description.no: Sikkerhetssystem som automatisk eller manuelt stenger ned prosessutstyr, isolerer beholdninger og stopper strømning når en farlig tilstand som brann, gasslekkasje eller overtrykk oppdages. Bygget i tre lag: sensorer, en logikkenhet som kjører årsak-virkning-logikk, og sluttelementer som ESD-ventiler som feiler til sikker posisjon.

entries.note: ESD is part of a Safety Instrumented System (SIS), governed by IEC 61508 and IEC 61511. Each function gets a SIL (Safety Integrity Level) from 1 to 4 — offshore ESD loops typically target SIL 2 or SIL 3. On the Norwegian shelf, NORSOK S-001 and Offshore Norge Guideline 070 (formerly OLF 070) set the detailed requirements. The hardware is bought certified off the shelf from vendors such as Honeywell, Schneider Electric (Triconex), ABB, Siemens and Yokogawa, then configured per installation.
entries._source: Web research: IEC 61511/61508 summaries, Offshore Norge 070, NORSOK S-001 references, Sept 2026

gist.en: Getting more oil out of an ageing field
gist.no: Å hente ut mer olje fra et modent felt

description.en: Techniques used to recover oil that ordinary pressure depletion and water injection leave behind, such as gas injection, polymer flooding or CO2 injection. Also called tertiary recovery.
description.no: Teknikker for å utvinne olje som vanlig trykkavlastning og vanninjeksjon lar bli igjen, som gassinjeksjon, polymerflømming eller CO2-injeksjon. Også kalt tertiærutvinning.

gist.en: Natural gas chilled to liquid for shipping
gist.no: Naturgass nedkjølt til væske for skipsfrakt

description.en: Natural gas cooled to about minus 162 degrees Celsius so it becomes liquid and shrinks to roughly 1/600 of its volume, making it practical to ship in tankers rather than by pipeline.
description.no: Naturgass nedkjølt til rundt minus 162 grader celsius slik at den blir flytende og krymper til omtrent 1/600 av volumet, noe som gjør den praktisk å frakte med tankskip i stedet for rørledning.

gist.en: Norway’s offshore oil and gas area
gist.no: Norges olje- og gassområde til havs

description.en: The seabed areas under Norwegian jurisdiction where petroleum activity takes place — the North Sea, the Norwegian Sea and the Barents Sea. The term the industry uses for the Norwegian offshore province as a whole.
description.no: Havbunnsområdene under norsk jurisdiksjon hvor petroleumsvirksomhet foregår — Nordsjøen, Norskehavet og Barentshavet. Begrepet bransjen bruker om den norske sokkelen som helhet.

description.en: The formal development plan licensees must get approved before building out a field on the Norwegian shelf — covering concept, facilities, cost, schedule, safety and environmental impact. No major contracts may be signed and no construction started until it is approved. It comes in two parts: the development plan itself and an impact assessment.
description.no: Den formelle utbyggingsplanen rettighetshavere må få godkjent før et felt bygges ut på norsk sokkel — konsept, innretninger, kostnad, fremdrift, sikkerhet og miljøkonsekvenser. Ingen vesentlige kontrakter kan inngås og ingen byggevirksomhet startes før den er godkjent. Den består av to deler: selve utbyggingsdelen og en konsekvensutredningsdel.

entries._source: Web research: regjeringen.no PUD pages and approval letters, Sokkeldirektoratet, SNL, Sept 2026
entries.note: Approved by Energidepartementet (renamed from Olje- og energidepartementet/OED in 2024), after advice from Sokkeldirektoratet (formerly Oljedirektoratet) and Havindustritilsynet (formerly Petroleumstilsynet/Ptil). Developments above roughly NOK 20 billion in investment go to the Stortinget for approval; smaller ones the ministry can approve alone. The sibling term PAD (plan for anlegg og drift) covers transport and processing facilities rather than a field.

gist.en: Keeping people and the environment safe
gist.no: Å holde folk og miljøet trygt

description.en: The discipline and organisation responsible for protecting people and the environment in operations — risk assessment, incident reporting, procedures and safety culture. Sometimes extended to HSEQ with quality.
description.no: Fagområdet og organisasjonen som er ansvarlig for å beskytte mennesker og miljø i driften — risikovurdering, hendelsesrapportering, prosedyrer og sikkerhetskultur. Utvides noen ganger til HSEQ med kvalitet lagt til.

gist.en: Risky activities happening at the same time

description.en: Two or more potentially conflicting activities carried out at the same time and place, such as drilling while producing or lifting near live process. Requires a dedicated risk assessment and coordination plan.
description.no: To eller flere potensielt motstridende aktiviteter utført på samme sted og tid, som boring samtidig med produksjon eller løft nær en aktiv prosess. Krever en egen risikovurdering og koordineringsplan.

gist.en: The master drawing of pipes and instruments

description.en: Detailed engineering drawing showing all pipes, valves, vessels, instruments and control loops in a process system. The primary reference document for operations, maintenance and modifications.
description.no: Detaljert ingeniørtegning som viser alle rør, ventiler, tanker, instrumenter og reguleringssløyfer i et prosessystem. Hovedreferansedokumentet for drift, vedlikehold og endringer.

gist.en: Wells with extreme pressure and temperature
gist.no: Brønner med ekstremt trykk og temperatur

description.en: Wells where pressure or temperature is extreme enough to need specially rated equipment, materials and drilling practices. Definitions vary: the common industry threshold is a bottom-hole temperature above 150°C (300°F) or pressure control equipment rated above 690 bar (10,000 psi), while API Technical Report 1PER15K-1 sets higher bars — 103 MPa (15,000 psi) and 177°C (350°F). A well often meets only one of the two conditions, not both.
description.no: Brønner der trykk eller temperatur er så ekstremt at det kreves spesielt klassifisert utstyr, materialer og boremetoder. Definisjonene varierer: den vanlige bransjegrensen er bunnhullstemperatur over 150 °C (300 °F) eller trykkontrollutstyr klassifisert over 690 bar (10 000 psi), mens API Technical Report 1PER15K-1 setter høyere grenser — 103 MPa (15 000 psi) og 177 °C (350 °F). En brønn oppfyller ofte bare ett av de to kriteriene, ikke begge.

entries._source: Web research: SLB Energy Glossary, API TR 1PER15K-1 summaries, ScienceDirect, Sept 2026
entries.note: The term came into industry use after the Cullen report into the Piper Alpha disaster in the UK North Sea. Beyond HPHT, the industry also uses ultra-HPHT (around 205°C / 138 MPa) and extreme HPHT (around 260°C / 241 MPa).

gist.en: Capturing CO2 and storing it underground
gist.no: Å fange CO2 og lagre det under bakken

description.en: Capturing CO2 from industrial or power sources, transporting it and injecting it into deep geological formations, often depleted reservoirs or saline aquifers, for permanent storage.
description.no: Å fange CO2 fra industri- eller kraftkilder, transportere det og injisere det i dype geologiske formasjoner, ofte tomme reservoarer eller saltvannsakviferer, for permanent lagring.

entries._source: Web research: Prop. 1 S (2025–2026) Energidepartementet, Sept 2026
entries.note: Norway runs one of the most advanced full-chain CCS projects: Langskip, with Northern Lights as its transport and storage arm. It came into operation in autumn 2025, with the first CO2 from Heidelberg Materials' Brevik cement plant injected beneath the seabed in August 2025. A phase 2 expansion approved in June 2025 lifts storage capacity from 1.5 to at least 5 million tonnes of CO2 per year.
